items.title: How Stretto built an AI voice agent with Amazon Nova 2 Sonic
items.summary: Stretto replaced its web-form lead capture with Tara, an AI voice agent built on Amazon Nova 2 Sonic that conducts bankruptcy intake interviews by phone and qualifies leads. See how Stretto, the AWS Generative AI Innovation Center, and CI&T designed the voice architecture, validated it for sensitive conversations, and moved it to production.
items.creator: Mariah Miller

items.title: From reporting to reasoning: Getting enterprise data ready for AI agents
items.summary: A recap of the inaugural AWS Quick User Group DC meetup, where data leaders explored getting enterprise data ready for AI agents. It covers what's new in AWS Quick, Financial Independence Group's AI analytics journey, and hands-on app and no-code flow building.
items.creator: Jane Ridge
